text:
The Last Dive - Official Trailer (2026)
Don't miss the Official Trailer for The Last Dive, a heartfelt documentary distributed by Area 23A. Witness the depths of a friendship in The Last Dive, coming to theaters and a global virtual cinema event on November 10.

Terry is a legendary figure in Baja, Mexico, an American veteran who has spent decades living on (and in) the water. Once a man burdened by a troubled past, Terry’s life was transformed by an unlikely friendship with Willy, a 22-foot oceanic manta ray. In the spirit of My Octopus Teacher, this film tells the story of a friendship that spanned two decades. 

Willy would slap his wings against the hull of Terry’s sailboat to signal their next dive, and together they explored the ocean’s depths. An extraordinary bond that turned Terry into an unexpected conservationist. Now in his 80s, Terry embarks on one final journey to a remote island in hopes of reuniting with his old friend. But he’s also searching for something deeper: peace, closure, and a chance to say goodbye.

The Last Dive is coming to theaters and a global virtual cinema event on November 10.

text:
Fallout Shelter: The Experiment - Official Date Announcement Teaser Trailer
Don't miss the Date Announcement Teaser for Fallout Shelter: The Experiment, an upcoming Fallout-themed reality competition series distributed by Prime Video. Vault Dwellers will compete for the top prize in Fallout Shelter: The Experiment, streaming on January 13, 2027, on Prime Video.

Fallout Shelter: The Experiment is a new reality competition series that invites everyday participants to test their aptitude for the apocalypse in Vault-Tec's state-of-the-art bomb-proof vault shelters. They will go head to head in a series of high-octane drills, psychological dilemmas, and morally challenging behavior trials until one special dweller emerges to win the prize of a lifetime--$1,000,000.

Fallout Shelter: The Experiment is executive produced by Amina Badresingh, Toni Ireland, Stephen Lovelock, Stephen Yemoh, Jack Burgess, Tim Harcourt and Stephen Lambert of Studio Lambert; Jonathan Nolan, Lisa Joy and Athena Wickham of Kilter Films; and James Altman and Todd Howard of Bethesda Game Studios.

Fallout Shelter: The Experiment is streaming on January 13, 2027, on Prime Video.
